text:
marta (finance): FYI — got ~20 NetSuite sync failures last night. All tied to usage invoices from the pricing experiment (tiered discounts). NetSuite rejected because one invoice line was negative after rounding + tax.

josh (eng-billing): ugh. do we have an example invoice id?

marta (finance): invoice_2026_09_14_88 (I'll paste webhook payload below). NetSuite error: "Line amount must be >= 0" then the nightly job retried and created a compensating memo that doesn't match the Stripe net.

anika (revops): that explains the revenue recognition alert I raised — AR report flagged mismatch to Stripe. Was this the experiment that applied a percentage discount and also auto-credited usage over threshold?

marta (finance): yes — we had two rules: 1) tiered discount (5% up to 1000u then 15%), 2) promo cap that applies a negative adjustment line for the overflow. The combo + tax rounding created -0.01 for some customers.

billing-bot: webhook_retry: invoice.created invoice_2026_09_14_88 attempts=3 status=400 ns_reject="Line amount must be >= 0"

leo (eng-platform): can you paste the webhook body we sent? want to确认 whether our serialization truncated decimals.

marta (finance): here (sanitized):
```json
{
  "id": "invoice_2026_09_14_88",
  "customer": "cus_FOO",
  "lines": [
    {"description":"usage (u)", "quantity": 1025, "unit_price": 0.05, "amount": 51.25},
    {"description":"tiered discount", "amount": -7.6875},
    {"description":"promo overflow adj", "amount": -43.56249999999999},
    {"description":"tax", "amount": 0.0}
  ],
  "total": 0.0
}
```

josh (eng-billing): that promo overflow amount looks like a JS floating point artifact (the 43.56249999999999). When we round to 2 decimal places for NetSuite we end up with -43.56 and combined with other rounding yields -0.01 on a line. NetSuite doesn't accept negative final line amounts. We should have a business rule to floor at -0.00 or convert negatives to zero for line items before sync.

anika (revops): can we surface this to CS? Affected customers are mid-market and will see phantom memos. Need hold on any auto-notices until fixed.

marta (finance): flagged in cs_queue. Also two invoices already processed into NetSuite created manual credit memos that didn't tie back to Stripe, so we'll need a journal entry cleanup.

leo (eng-platform): quick mitigation: we'll add server-side normalization: for every line, round to 2 decimals, then if amount < 0 and abs(amount) < 0.05 set to 0.00 and add a note. Pushing a hotfix now to staging.

josh (eng-billing): also pushing a validation to the webhook producer: coerce numeric to decimal string with fixed 2 decimals and include a "rounded_by": "sync" metadata key so we can trace. We'll patch the nightly sync to skip negative lines and surface a reconciliation alert.

billing-bot: deploy started: billing-normalize-lines v1.1 -> staging (sha: d1f4c9).

marta (finance): rad. timeline? CS needs ~2hr heads-up before we flip to prod.

leo (eng-platform): if staging looks green, can do a controlled rollout to prod in 3h. We'll also add a backfill job to re-evaluate invoices in the last 72h with a reconciliation report.

anika (revops): please add a list of affected invoice ids to the cs ticket. I'll prepare customer messaging template in case of manual memos.

josh (eng-billing): noted. I'll attach the raw webhook payloads for the error set to the ticket. Also adding unit tests for combinations of tiered discount + promo overflow.

marta (finance): thanks. follow-ups: 1) cleanup journal entries in NetSuite (finance ops), 2) backfill reconciliation run, 3) disable experiment if any edge cases remain.

leo (eng-platform): will monitor staging, ping here when deploy done. :eyes:

billing-bot: deploy succeeded: billing-normalize-lines v1.1 -> staging (sha: d1f4c9)

leo (eng-platform): staging looks good on sample set (no negative lines after normalization). prepping prod rollout with canary 5% of invoices.

marta (finance): canary sounds good. CS queue updated with affected ids and messaging draft. thanks all. :raised_hands:
